consensus.title: Duplicate method definition causing syntax error

responses.content: NO_ISSUES_FOUND: Correct, safe, well-structured, and no simpler version is worth the change.

[CRITICAL] LOGIC <Duplicate method definition causing syntax error> (at symbol/line)
- Issue: The added `_evict_oldest` method duplicates an existing method, resulting in a duplicate definition error that prevents the class from being defined, causing a crash on import.
- Fix: Remove the duplicated method definition; keep only the existing `_evict_oldest` implementation.

[WARNING] STRUCTURE <Method duplicated, breaking class invariants> (at symbol/line)
- Issue: Adding a duplicate `_evict_oldest` method creates two definitions, forcing any future change to edit multiple locations and risking inconsistent behavior.
- Fix: Delete the duplicated method definition.
